name: Angel A Spirit
overview: Scripture reveals angels as celestial spirits who serve as God's messengers and ministers, evident in their appearances to Hagar, Abraham, and Lot. They are described as the 'angel of the LORD,' actively engaging in God's purposes by delivering guidance and protection. These beings are part of the heavenly host created by God, distinct in their orders and roles, yet always obedient and holy, demonstrating God's power and wisdom in their interactions with humanity.
